result.topic_en: Orbit-determination formulas: the squared distance kk expressed through the Sun–Earth radii R, R′ and longitudes A, A′, transformed with auxiliary quantities E, F, H, V and e, f, h, v, followed by relations between three geocentric distances Δ, Δ′, Δ″ at times u, u′, u″.
result.transcription:
40 Mo-
40 nath.
1810
Litt: D.

$kk = RR + R'R' - 2RR'\cos(A'-A)$
$+2\varrho\left\{\begin{matrix} R'\cos(A'-\alpha) - R\cos(A-\alpha) \\ +MR\cos(A-\alpha') - MR'\cos(A'-\alpha')\end{matrix}\right\}$
$+\varrho\varrho\left\{\begin{matrix} 1-2M\cos(\alpha'-\alpha)+MM \\ +(\mathrm{tg}\,6-[-M-]M\,\mathrm{tg}\,6')^2\end{matrix}\right\}$
Es sei $(R'-R)\cos\tfrac12(A'-A) = E = H\cos V$
$(R'+R)\sin\tfrac12(A'-A) = F = H\sin V$
$kk = EE + FF$
$+2\varrho\left\{\begin{matrix} E\cos(\tfrac12 A+\tfrac12 A'-\alpha) - F\sin(\tfrac12 A+\tfrac12 A'-\alpha) \\ [-+-]-ME\cos(\tfrac12 A+\tfrac12 A'-\alpha') + [-M-]MF\sin(\tfrac12 A+\tfrac12 A'-\alpha')\end{matrix}\right\}$
$+\varrho\varrho\left\{\begin{matrix} 1-2M\cos(\alpha'-\alpha)+MM \\ +(\mathrm{tg}\,6-[-M-]M\,\mathrm{tg}\,6')^2\end{matrix}\right\}$
$(M-[-1-]1)\cos\tfrac12(\alpha'-\alpha) = e = h\cos v$ $\quad \tfrac12(A+A'-\alpha-\alpha') = \zeta$
$(M+1)\sin\tfrac12(\alpha'-\alpha) = f = h\sin v$
$kk = EE + FF$ $\quad = HH [-+-]-2\varrho Hh\left(\begin{matrix}-\cos\zeta\cos V-v \\ +\sin\zeta\sin V-v\end{matrix}\right)$
$+2\varrho\left(\begin{matrix}-eE\cos\zeta + eF\sin\zeta \\ -fE\sin\zeta - fF\cos\zeta\end{matrix}\right)$ $\quad = HH - 2\varrho Hh\cos(\zeta+V-v) + \varrho\varrho\,(hh + (\mathrm{tg}\,6 - M\,\mathrm{tg}\,6')^2)$
$+\varrho\varrho\{ee+ff+(\mathrm{tg}\,6-M\,\mathrm{tg}\,6')^2\}$

$\Delta''\dfrac{\sin(\alpha''-\alpha)}{u''-u} = \Delta'\left([-M-]1-\tfrac12(u'-u)(u''-u')\tfrac{1}{r'^3}\right)\dfrac{\sin(\alpha'-\alpha)}{u'-u} - \tfrac12(u''-u')\sin(V'-\alpha)\,.\,R'\left(\tfrac{1}{R'^3}-\tfrac{1}{r'^3}\right)$
$\Delta''\dfrac{\theta''[-\ldots-] - \theta\cos(\alpha''-\alpha)}{u''-u} = \Delta'\left(1-\tfrac12(u'-u)(u''-u')\tfrac{1}{r'^3}\right)\dfrac{\theta'[-\theta\cos(\alpha'+\alpha)-]}{u'-u} + \tfrac12(u''-u')\,\theta\cos(V'-\alpha)\,R'\left(\tfrac{1}{R'^3}-\tfrac{1}{r'^3}\right)$
oder
$\Delta''\dfrac{\theta''\cos(\alpha'-\alpha) - \theta\cos(\alpha''-\alpha')}{u''-u} = \Delta'\left(1-\tfrac12(u'-u)(u''-u')\tfrac{1}{r'^3}\right)\left(\dfrac{\theta\cos(\alpha'-\alpha)+\theta}{u'-u}\right) + \tfrac12(u''-u')\,\theta\cos(V'-\alpha')\,R'\left(\tfrac{1}{R'^3}-\tfrac{1}{r'^3}\right)$
$\Delta''\dfrac{\theta''\sin(V'-\alpha) - \theta\sin(V'-\alpha'')}{u''-u} = \Delta'\left(1-\tfrac12(u'-u)(u''-u')\tfrac{1}{r'^3}\right)\dfrac{\theta'\sin(V'-\alpha) - \theta\sin(V'-\alpha')}{u'-u}$

methods.what: Squared distance between two points as a quadratic in the geocentric distance ρ
Auxiliary quantities E, F, H, V reducing the constant term to EE+FF=HH
Auxiliary quantities e, f, h, v and angle ζ combining the linear term into a single cosine
Compact form of kk as quadratic in ρ
Approximate relation between geocentric distances Δ′, Δ″ at three times using series terms in (u′−u)(u″−u′)/r′³
